title: Shifted Hom comparison for affine proper flat duality base change
statement: Let $Y,Y'$ be affine schemes and $X,Y,Y'$ quasi-compact quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be proper, flat and locally of finite presentation [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-flat-morphism], and $g:Y'\to Y$. Write $X'=X\times_Y Y'$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $a,a'$ be right adjoints of the quasi-coherent derived direct images and assume the canonical direct-image base-change transformation is invertible. Let $c:Lg_X^*a(K)\to a'(Lg^*K)$ be the canonical mate morphism [def-sc-duality-equation-base-change-map], with $K\in D_{QCoh}(Y)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. For every perfect $M\in D_{QCoh}(X)$ [def-pc-perfect-complex] and integers $m,n$, composition with $c[n]$ induces a bijection $\operatorname{Hom}(Lg_X^*M[m],Lg_X^*a(K)[n])\to\operatorname{Hom}(Lg_X^*M[m],a'(Lg^*K)[n])$.

source.place: Tag 0AA8 (lemma-more-base-change), equation duality-equation-iso, RHom comparisons and final compatibility diagram

proof.text: Identify affine schemes with spectra. Flatness gives stalkwise Tor independence, so the affine Hom-out-of-perfect comparison is invertible.
Apply proper-support perfect direct image to M and the structure sheaf concentrated in degree zero. Flatness, finite presentation, and properness imply that Rf_*M is perfect.
Apply both global Hom adjunctions, perfect RHom base change, and the assumed base-change inverse. Flat-precomposition compatibility identifies their composite with RHom of the canonical mate map.
Taking degree n-m cohomology of that canonical isomorphism and using the natural global RHom/shifted-Hom identification gives exactly composition with c[n].

theorem proper_flat_rightAdjoint_affine_baseChange_hom_bijective
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine Y] [IsAffine Y']
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y]
    [CompactSpace Y'] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y']
    (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsProper f] [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (a : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
    (a' : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y' ⥤
      schemeDerivedQCohCategory (pullback f g))
    (adjf : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty X).ι ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f)
      (fun E ↦ (schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint X Y f).fst E.obj E.property) ⊣ a)
    (adjf' : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y').lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback f g)).ι ⋙
        schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g))
      (fun E ↦ (@schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint _ _ _
        (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd f g)) _ _ _ _
        (pullback.snd f g) _ _).fst E.obj E.property) ⊣ a')
    (hβ : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
      IsIso (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g
        (pullback.fst f g) pullback.condition E.obj))
    [∀ U : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y)
    (M : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X) (hM : Scheme.IsPerfect X M.obj)
    (m n : ℤ) :
    Function.Bijective (fun t :
      ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj M.obj)⟦m⟧ ⟶
        ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj (a.obj K).obj)⟦n⟧ ↦
      t ≫ (dualityEquationBaseChangeMap f g a a' adjf adjf' hβ K).hom⟦n⟧')
